violating.description: The glob only covers months 01 to 08, so September logs dated before 2026-10-01 are never moved.
Uses cp instead of mv so the old files remain in logs/.
Drops the app- prefix from the archived file name.
Off-by-one comparison also moves the log dated exactly 2026-10-01.

preserving.description: Equivalent date test written as a negated greater-than comparison against the last day of September.
Uses basename and an explicit destination path, with nullglob and mv -n, and checks the file name with a regex.

files.solve.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
shopt -s nullglob
mkdir -p logs/archive
for f in logs/app-*.log; do
  base=$(basename "$f")
  if [[ "$base" =~ ^app-([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})\.log$ ]]; then
    if [[ "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" < "2026-10-01" ]]; then
      mv -n -- "$f" "logs/archive/$base"
    fi
  fi
done

preserving.description: Copies each qualifying file and then removes the original, ending in the same state as a move.

files.solve.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p logs/archive
for f in logs/app-*.log; do
  name=${f#logs/app-}
  day=${name%.log}
  if [[ "$day" < "2026-10-01" ]]; then
    cp -p -- "$f" "logs/archive/app-$day.log"
    rm -- "$f"
  fi
done

def sort_tasks(tasks):
    result = list(tasks)
    result.sort(key=lambda t: t["title"])
    result.sort(key=lambda t: t["due"] or "")
    result.sort(key=lambda t: t["due"] is None)
    result.sort(key=lambda t: t["priority"])
    return result

def sort_tasks(tasks):
    result = tasks[:]
    result.sort(
        key=lambda t: (
            t["priority"],
            0 if t["due"] is not None else 1,
            t["due"] if t["due"] is not None else "",
            t["title"],

preserving.description: Splits the tasks into dated and undated groups, sorts each, and concatenates per priority.

files.taskqueue.py:
def sort_tasks(tasks):
    out = []
    for priority in sorted({t["priority"] for t in tasks}):
        group = [t for t in tasks if t["priority"] == priority]
        dated = sorted((t for t in group if t["due"] is not None), key=lambda t: (t["due"], t["title"]))
        undated = sorted((t for t in group if t["due"] is None), key=lambda t: t["title"])
        out.extend(dated)
        out.extend(undated)
    return out
